argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
It is interesting to contemplate an entangled bank, clothed with many plants of many kinds, with birds singing on the bushes, with various insects flitting about, and with worms crawling through the damp earth, and to reflect that these elaborately constructed forms, so different from each other, and dependent on each other in so complex a manner, have all been produced by laws acting around us. These laws, taken in the largest sense, being Growth with Reproduction; Inheritance which is almost implied by reproduction; Variability from the indirect and direct action of the external conditions of life, and from use and disuse; a Ratio of Increase so high as to lead to a Struggle for Life, and as a consequence to Natural Selection, entailing Divergence of Character and the Extinction of less-improved forms. Thus, from the war of nature, from famine and death, the most exalted object which we are capable of conceiving, namely, the production of the higher animals, directly follows. There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed into a few forms or into one; and that, whilst this planet has gone cycling on according to the fixed law of gravity, from so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being, evolved.
</passage>

response.text:
It may, at some level, be considered a value-add exercise to engage in the contemplation of a multi-stakeholder ecosystem of biotic assets—an entangled-bank environment, so to speak—characterized by the deployment of numerous plant-based deliverables across multiple typological verticals, the operationalization of avian vocalization outputs within shrub-adjacent infrastructure, the flitting-related activity of various insect stakeholders, and the subsurface mobilization of vermiform entities within moisture-optimized soil environments; and it might, without undue commitment, be inferred that these highly complex structural outcomes, each differentiated in form and interdependent in ways not fully operationalizable within a single explanatory framework, could perhaps be understood as having been generated, at scale, through the leverage of certain law-based mechanisms currently in play across the broader environment.

These mechanisms, insofar as they can be characterized at the highest level of abstraction, may be said to encompass: Growth-and-Reproduction synergies; an Inheritance function that is arguably, though not without qualification, implicit within the reproduction process; a Variability parameter arising, to some degree, from both indirect and direct environmental-condition inputs, as well as from usage/non-usage differentials; and an Increase Ratio of such magnitude as to potentially necessitate a Struggle-for-Life dynamic, which in turn may operationalize, as a downstream consequence, a Natural Selection process—itself entailing Character-Divergence outcomes and the Extinction-pathway deprecation of comparatively under-optimized forms.

It could thus be suggested, albeit tentatively, that from the ongoing conflict-space of nature, and from the value-negative conditions of famine and mortality, what might arguably be regarded as the most elevated conceptual output achievable within human cognitive bandwidth—namely, the emergence of higher-order animal life-forms—could be said to follow, more or less directly, as an outcome.

There is, arguably, a certain grandeur-adjacent quality that might be attributed to this particular framing of life, together with its various embedded capabilities, which may or may not have been originally instantiated into a limited number of foundational forms, or perhaps into a single such form; and it might further be noted, without full certainty, that while this planetary body has continued its cycling operations in ostensible alignment with the fixed-law parameters of gravitational force, a wide array of maximally beautiful and maximally noteworthy forms—stemming from what could be characterized as a relatively simple point of origin—have been, and continue to be, progressively evolved, at scale, going forward.
